topic: Understand What It Means to Invest
subtopic: Understand What It Means to Invest
source_evidence: When investing, you have a greater chance of losing your money than when you save.
question: What does investing involve, compared with saving?
answer: Investing involves taking on some degree of risk: you have a greater chance of losing money than when you save. At the same time, investing gives you the opportunity to earn more money.
